title: SMOK TF-D Subtank
description:
The
SMOK TF-D Subtank
is a sub-ohm tank designed for direct-to-lung (DTL) vaping. Featuring top-fill design with child-proof lock, adjustable top airflow, and leak-proof construction. Uses SMOK D-Coil series coils.
Product Type:
Sub-Ohm Tank
Tank Capacity:
3.5mL (standard) / 5.5mL (bulb glass included)
Coil Type:
Replaceable - uses SMOK D-Coils
Coil Resistance:
0.15Ω / 0.23Ω / 0.4Ω D-Coils
Fill Method:
Top Fill with Child-Proof Lock
Airflow:
Adjustable Top Airflow
Connection:
510 Thread
Compatible Mods:
SMOK X-Priv Solo 80W, SMOK X-Priv Plus, or any 510-threaded mod
Brand:
SMOK
D-Coils and e-liquid sold separately. Suitable for freebase e-liquids at higher wattages.
Available options: Matte Black, Stainless Steel.
